title: Category $\mathcal{O}$ for truncated shifted Yangians and the bi-infinite Bott-Samelson variety
summary: In this paper, we study the category $\mathcal{O}$ of representations of shifted Yangians associated to a simply-laced simple Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ over $\mathbb{C}$. In particular, we prove that the (complexified) Grothendieck ring of this category is isomorphic to the Cox ring of the open bi-infinite Bott-Samelson variety, which is a pro-variety we construct from Bott-Samelson varieties for alternating heaps.
